notes: Four taḥwīl branches meet at «كلهم عن الزهري، بهذا الإسناد», so the Zuhri and the back-reference close every route (rule 3)
«وغيرهم» is an unnamed group of other transmitters (like «غير واحد»), so it is kept as unnamed in the first route
«مثل حديث يونس وعمرو» is a wording remark (one version says «ذكر الأكل», another «نهى عن كل ذي ناب»); the transmitters are the same, so it is left out (rule 4)
«حدثنا أبي، عن صالح» gives Yaqub's father as a bare relation; he is not named in the text
